DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer
Join our platform team to run production infrastructure for a fast-growing SaaS product.

What you'll do:
- Operate Kubernetes clusters on AWS
- Write and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform
- Improve CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and on-call

Must have:
- 4+ years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure roles
- Kubernetes in production
- Terraform
- AWS
Nice to have:
- Helm, Prometheus, Grafana
- GitHub Actions or Jenkins
- CKA certification

Location: Pune or Bengaluru (hybrid).

requirements.title: DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer
requirements.summary: DevOps/SRE running Kubernetes on AWS with Terraform and CI/CD.
